name: Electricity Bill
description: Schema for extracting information from electricity bills

fields.name: address_of_consuming_site
fields.description: The address of the site where the electricity is consumed, not a billing address

fields.name: start_date_of_consumption
fields.description: The start date of the consumption period

fields.name: end_date_of_consumption
fields.description: The end date of the consumption period

fields.name: total_amount_due
fields.description: The total amount due for payment

fields.name: consumption_amount
fields.description: The amount of electricity consumed in the period

fields.name: consumption_unit
fields.description: The unit of measurement for electricity consumption (e.g., kWh)

fields.name: payment_due_date
fields.description: The date by which payment must be made

fields.name: supplier_name
fields.description: The name of the electricity supplier company

fields.name: rate_plan
fields.description: The electricity rate plan or tariff

fields.name: peak_consumption
fields.description: The amount of electricity consumed during peak hours

fields.name: off_peak_consumption
fields.description: The amount of electricity consumed during off-peak hours
